title: Desktop Support Technician
description:
Entre Computer Services is Rochester's leading provider in technology services including Managed Services, IT Infrastructure Engineering & Architecture, Application Development, Hardware & Software Sales, and IT Outsourcing & Recruiting. Entre has been headquartered in Rochester, NY since 1984, and serves organizations both regionally and nationally. Entre is a family-oriented organization that provides great flexibility in professional growth, offers resources for individual success in a team environment, and recognizes the importance of work-life balance.

We are seeking an experienced Desktop Support Technician to provide on-site technical support and troubleshooting for end-user hardware, software, and network-related issues. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem-solver with strong technical expertise and excellent customer service skills, capable of resolving a broad range of IT support tasks independently and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities:
• Acts as a liaison with end-user for computer related issues and escalations.
• Acts as a technical resource in assisting customers to assess and resolve hardware and software issues.
• Install and configure computers, monitors, and peripherals such as printers, scanners, smartphones and other related hardware.
• Upgrade operating systems and software.
• Assist with new project requests as needed.
• Create and update documentation as needed.
• Track and document, within the ticketing system, progress and steps taken to resolve issues.
• Performs and assists in hardware and software maintenance services.
• Report on trends.
• Participate in the major incident identification and resolution process.
• Performs on-call responsibilities.
• Able to work a flexible schedule (hours may vary), work after-hours calls, may include some evenings and weekends as needed.
• Maintains a high degree of computer expertise.
• Troubleshoots and resolves tickets for issues and requests for new mobile equipment, features, and functionality for customer's in-person, remotely, and by phone support.
• Maintains mobile device inventory management.
• Provides Level I technical support in assisting IT Support Services team members with setup, configuration, maintenance, and reported problems for mobile devices.
• Performs other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:
• Associate's degree in Computer Science or related field preferred.
• 2-3 years of Information Technology experience preferred.
